title: FRIDAY ARMS AND GENTLE CORE
subtitle: LIGHT ARM WORK AND SLOW CORE IN THE CHAIR, THEN WALL PUSH-UPS, A KIND HIP STRETCH AND BALANCE. NO FLOOR TODAY.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Friday is arms and a little gentle core, about eleven minutes. In the chair we'll do slow knee lifts for the tummy, a row, a light press, and a soft figure four. Then we stand for wall push ups, a kind hip flexor stretch, and balance at the chair. No floor today. A smaller range is fine on sore-joint days. Lovely to see you.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, shoulders soft, and take one slow easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush at all.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. Arms worked, tummy switched on, hips looked after, and you showed up again on a Friday. Another small win in the book. Have a sip of water and enjoy your weekend. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED SLOW KNEE LIFTS (GENTLE CORE)
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, hands lightly holding the sides of the seat. Gently draw the tummy in, as if zipping up a coat. Slowly lift one foot an inch or two off the floor, hold for a breath, and lower with control. Alternate legs. Keep the back tall and the lifts low so nothing pinches at the front of the hip, especially the left. Keep breathing throughout. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Slow seated knee lifts for gentle core. Six each leg, twice through. Tummy gently in, sit tall, lift one foot just a little, hold a breath, and lower slowly. Keep it low on the left side.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet down. Let the tummy relax.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. Core nicely switched on.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair. With light hand weights, a band, or just empty hands, reach forward then draw the elbows back close to your sides and gently squeeze the shoulder blades together. Slow and smooth. Shoulders stay down, away from the ears. Empty hands are perfectly fine.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Ten slow ones, twice through. Reach forward, draw the elbows back, and gently squeeze the shoulder blades. Weights or empty hands, both are fine.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Drop the shoulders and breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Rows done. Lovely tall posture, Pam.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall with feet flat. Hold light hand weights, or nothing at all, at shoulder height. Press up slowly, only as high as is comfortable, then lower with control. On sore-joint days, press only halfway or use empty hands. Never push through shoulder pain.
exercises.speakStart: Light overhead press. Eight slow ones, twice through. Press up only as high as feels comfy, and lower with control. Empty hands are perfectly fine.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Arms down. Shake them out.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat. Rest the right ankle over the left thigh, just above the knee. Stay tall and tip forward from the hips only a touch, until you feel a mild stretch in the outer hip. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Never press the knee down or fold deep. If the left groin or front of the hip pinches, skip that side or simply rest the ankle without leaning. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. About twenty seconds each side. Rest one ankle over the other thigh, sit tall, and tip forward just a touch. Skip the left side if it pinches.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. That's the chair work finished. Stay seated, we'll stand up next.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: Stand about an arm's length from the wall, feet hip-width. Place your hands flat on the wall at shoulder height, a little wider than the shoulders. Keep the body in one long line and the tummy gently in. Bend the elbows to bring the chest towards the wall, then press back slowly. Stand closer to make it easier; a small bend is perfectly fine on sore-joint days. No pain in the wrists or shoulders.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups. Eight slow ones, twice through. Hands on the wall, body long, bend the elbows and press away. Step closer to make it easier.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Shake out the arms.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Strong arms, Pam.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with one hand lightly on the chair back. Step one foot back about half a step, not a deep lunge, both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the back hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds, then swap. Start with the left leg back and keep that side extra gentle. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing hip flexor. About twenty seconds each leg. Hand on the chair, small step back, tuck the pelvis, tiny lean. Left leg first, extra gentle.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Hip flexor stretch done. Front of the hips looked after.

exercises.name: CHAIR-SUPPORTED BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand tall behind the chair with both hands resting lightly on the back. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot, just off the floor. Keep the standing knee soft, shoulders back and down, eyes ahead. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch. Grip the chair as much as you need; toes touching down is perfectly fine. Keep the lifted leg low and relaxed so nothing pinches at the front of the hip.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. About fifteen seconds each leg, twice through. Hands on the chair, stand tall, and lift one foot just off the floor. Toes can touch down any time.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Arms, core and kind hips. Have a lovely Friday.
